whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Shreeja Family Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has a great location near Sreeleather on Fraser Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table bookings and food menu inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://shreejafamilyrestaurant.example.com

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Shreeja Family Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital menu, direct WhatsApp table reservation, and quick directions for Fraser Road customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
